questions.question: Which describes a server-side language? Choices: the code is hidden from the user; enables you to adjust the interface in response to the user; decreases the work load on the user computer; the code is processed locally.

Which statement about JavaScript is true? Choices: JavaScript must be in <script> tags; JavaScript must be in the <head> tags; JavaScript and Java are the same language; JavaScript must be saved in an external file.

Which describes a client-side language? Choices: decreases the work load on the user computer; the code is hidden from the user; enables you to adjust the interface in response to the user; the code is processed locally.
Which is a client-side scripting language? Choices: PHP; JavaScript; Java; C++.
PHP and JavaScript use many of the same concepts and look very similar in terms of code. Choices: True; False.
Which is a server-side scripting language? Choices: Java; C++; PHP; JavaScript.

Which is true concerning file types? Choices: PHP code inside HTML files can use the <script language='php'></script> tags; PHP code inside HTML files can use the <? and ?> tags; PHP files have a .php extension; PHP code inside HTML files use the <?php and ?> tags.
Which type of error would you receive if you are missing a bracket? Choices: Logical; Warning; Parsing.
Which type of system message would be caused if you didn't create a variable you refer to in a program? Choices: Warnings; Notices; Erros.
Which type of system message informs the programmer of code they may have intended to add, but PHP can do without it, like creating a variable for you? Choices: Warnings; Errors; Notices.

Which of these statements are true concerning error reporting? Choices: Is not confusing for users; Can expose sensitive information; Error reporting must be enabled; Types of errors to be displayed can be specified.
What type of error can be resolved using temporary output statements to follow the value of a variable or trace the execution of a script? Choices: Logical; Parsing; No answer text provided; Notices.
Which type of system message would you see if you are missing a semi-colon? Choices: Notices; Warning; Error.
Which type of error will give you information on the type of error? Choices: Parsing; No answer text provided; Notices; Logical.
Which type of system message informs the programmer that something has gone wrong with a script, but it does not stop it from running? Choices: Notices; Warnings; Erros.
Which displays output to the screen? Choices: console.output(); document.write; alert function; outterHTML.
Which is the correct syntax for output? Choices: <?php echo "Hello, World!"; ?>; <?php echo (Hello, World!); ?>; <?php echo ("Hello, World!"); ?>.
Which is true concerning constants? Choices: Starts with dollar sign; Some are predefined; Doesn't change; Cannot embed in a string.
Which counter options can be altered to allow an increment of more than one? Choices: $counter = $counter + 1; $counter++; $counter +=1.
Which quote will be examined by the interpreter for anything that can be processed by PHP? Choices: Single quotes; Double quotes.
Which character is used to assign a value to a variable? Choices: =; ==; :.
Which is true concerning variables? Choices: created and used when a script runs; Used to reference pieces of information; expected to change value as the script runs; used for a short span of time.
Which can be done by functions to manipulate strings? Choices: capitalizing all or one word; breaking strings apart; finding and replacing.
Which is true concerning PHP variable formatting? Choices: Can have a space; Can begin with a number; Must begin with a dollar sign ($); Typically has an underscore (_) as a second character.
Which is true concerning $_POST and $_GET? Choices: Used by forms to transmit data; Always available; They are arrays; They are reserved variables.
Which is the act of connecting several items into one output? Choices: concatenation; Object; Reference; NULL.
Which is an empty, unused, or unset variable? Choices: NULL; Object; Resource; Array.
Which type of variables are decimal values such as 1.33 or 34.2325? Choices: Boolean; Integer; Floating; String.

Which is true concerning sessions? Choices: stores information on the server; stores information on the user's computer; sessions can be used with cookies simultaneously; will work when user blocks cookies.
Which type of variables contain any number of characters? Choices: Floating; Integer; String; Boolean.
Object-oriented programming is commonly used in most web pages. Choices: True; False.
Which is a special variable that holds reference points to things like files? Choices: Resource; Object; NULL; Array.
Data streams are long strings of characters formatted to convey information between systems. Choices: True; False.

Which is true concerning JSON? Choices: uses colons to separate value pairs; delimits objects with nested brackets and quoted values; uses colons to denote value pairs; acronym for JavaScript Object Notation.
Which is true concerning XML? Choices: similar to HTML; Tags are user defined; abbreviation of eXpandable Markup Language; abbreviation of eXtensible Markup Language.
Which functions convert JSON to and from arrays? Choices: json_encode; json_extract; json_array; json_decode.
Which of these represents $a is less than or equal to $b? Choices: $a => $b; $a >= $b; $a =< $b; $a <= $b.
What does SimpleXML allow the PHP programmer to do? Choices: Create XML content; Navigate XML content; Edit XML content; Encode XML content.

Which is true concerning data streams? Choices: focus on the ability to quickly convey information in as readable a format as possible; frequently used to transmit responses between the server and the user's browser; result in a compressed syntax to identify the information and its meaning; Must be complete, raw information.
Which of these represents $a is not equal to $b? Choices: $a >< $b; $a != $b; $a == $b; $a <> $b.
